voiceSummary: KPIT Technologies Limited has intimated participation in two investor conferences. The Avendus Spark INDS Annual Conference is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, in Mumbai. The JM Financial India Xchange Annual Conference is scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, 2026, in Mumbai. Company officials will reiterate information communicated during the Post Earnings Conference Call held on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these events. A presentation is available at the specified weblink.
